articles.title: How to request a mentor
articles.content: Approved students submit one mentoring request with a pathway (job, higher studies, venture), a domain and a specific problem statement of at least 80 characters. Only one open request is allowed at a time.

articles.title: What happens after you submit a request
articles.content: IIC reviews every request, looks at suggested mentors and sends an availability check to one mentor at a time. The mentor has seven days to confirm or decline.

articles.title: How IIC approves a match
articles.content: A mentorship starts only after the mentor confirms availability and an IIC administrator approves the pairing. AI suggestions are advisory and never approve anything.

articles.title: Withdrawing a request
articles.content: Students can withdraw an open request from My Requests. Pending availability checks are expired automatically.

articles.title: Logging meetings
articles.content: Either participant logs a meeting with the date, duration and status (held, cancelled, no show). Mentors confirm meetings logged by students. Conversation content is never recorded.

articles.title: Setting shared goals
articles.content: Each mentorship can have up to three shared goals with a target date. Mark a goal complete when it is achieved.

articles.title: Giving feedback to IIC
articles.content: Feedback is private to IIC. Students and mentors can send general, progress, change mentor or closing feedback. There are no star ratings.

articles.title: Changing your mentor
articles.content: If the mentorship is not working, submit change mentor feedback. IIC will review it and may close the mentorship and help you find another mentor.

articles.title: Mentor verification
articles.content: Alumni mentors are invited by IIC and must be verified before they can receive availability checks. Verification checks alumni records.

articles.title: Responding to an availability check
articles.content: Mentors open the availability inbox, read the anonymised need and confirm or decline within seven days. Student contact details are shared only after IIC approval.

articles.title: Fortnightly progress feedback
articles.content: Mentors are reminded to send progress feedback every fourteen days. Missing feedback raises a reminder for IIC.

articles.title: Inactivity alerts
articles.content: If no meeting is held for fourteen days IIC receives an inactivity alert and may follow up with the pair.

articles.title: Recording outcomes
articles.content: Students record outcomes such as an internship, job offer, admission or venture milestone with the date achieved.

articles.title: Closing a mentorship
articles.content: IIC closes a mentorship with a reason when goals are met or the pair stops meeting. Both participants are notified.

articles.title: Privacy at Sangam
articles.content: Sangam never stores chat messages with Ask Sangam, never shows ratings and shares contact details only after approval. Personal data is removed before any AI call.

articles.title: Student registration and approval
articles.content: Students register with an IITM email address. IIC approves the profile before the student can request mentoring.

articles.title: Mentor availability toggle
articles.content: Mentors can switch their availability off when they are busy. Unavailable mentors are not suggested.

articles.title: AI mentor suggestions
articles.content: IIC sees ranked mentor suggestions with short reasons such as same domain and shared skills. The ranking is advisory and IIC decides.

articles.title: Request priority
articles.content: Each request gets a suggested priority based on waiting time, deadlines and urgency. IIC can override it with a reason.

articles.title: Session summaries
articles.content: Mentors can turn their own notes into a draft summary and action items. Nothing is saved unless the mentor confirms it.

articles.title: Admin insights
articles.content: IIC dashboard shows participation and effectiveness numbers and flags mentorships that may be going quiet.

articles.title: Exporting data
articles.content: IIC can export pair level counts to CSV for reporting. The export contains no conversation content.

articles.title: Notifications and email
articles.content: Sangam sends in-app notifications and emails when a request status changes, a check is sent or a match is approved.

articles.title: Pathways explained
articles.content: Job pathway is for placements and internships, higher studies for MS PhD or MBA applications, venture for founders, and unsure if you want help deciding.

articles.title: Resetting your password
articles.content: Use the forgot password link on the login page. Sangam staff will never ask for your password.
